$comment: Known contrast failures the check tolerates. Each entry: browser (chromium, firefox or *), input (dials.css, theme:<name>, random:<n>:<kind>, a prefix ending in *, or *), scheme (light, dark, band or *), pair ('--fg on --bg'), mode (normal, the default, or fallback: only in the --fallback run) and a reason. Keep this short: fix the derivation rather than adding to it. A theme never gets an exception.

exceptions.reason: Fallback only: without relative colour, on-solid text can't follow the fill's luminance, so it's always white, with the fill pulled a fixed amount towards the other end. That holds 4.5:1 for every theme but not for extreme random fills (a near-white or yellow brand, say). Normal mode has no exception.
